method.cited: Saved per-Seed metrics/disease TP/support/Recall, aggregate means/SD, paired deltas and mean paired deltas vs224.
method.derived: 512-320 same-Seed differences; missing paired SD, TP/count mean/SD and count differences; no metrics recalculation.
method.confusion_matrix_use: Direct read of existing MEL->NV/DF->BCC cells only, not matrix reconstruction or metric computation.
method.NA: PAD DF/VASC recall and TP null, support0; excluded, not zero scores.
method.units: Raw fractions retained full precision in JSON; report x100 for percentages/pp. Supports per Seed, no pooled Seed sample counts.
